import json,re
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('.agents/skills/3d-model-pipeline/references/concept-sheet.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')

assert m, 'section 11 not found'
tail=s[m.start():]
n=re.search(r'(?m)"'^##(?!#)'"\\s+',tail[1:])
section=tail if n is None else tail[:n.start()+1]
paths=['tools/art/acceptance/asset-acceptance-2.output-concept.schema.json','art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-LEATHERHEAD-001/asset-card.yaml','art/imagegen/concept-leatherhead-codex/palette.json','art/imagegen/concept-leatherhead-codex/design/checks-report.json','art/imagegen/concept-leatherhead-codex/generation-records.json','art/imagegen/concept-leatherhead-codex/verification.json']
print(json.dumps({'section_11':section,**{p:Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig') for p in paths}},ensure_ascii=True))
'@ | python -"
